"""Test 13: the report's tables, written from fits-t13.json by code (tables-t13.md), so that no number is copied by hand.

Usage: python -B tables_t13.py"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
d = json.loads((OUT / "fits-t13.json").read_text())
NAMES = {"t11-job2": "test 11, job 2", "t11-job3": "test 11, job 3", "t12-job1": "test 12"}


def f(x, n=2):
    return "" if x is None else f"{x:.{n}f}".replace("-", "−")


def main():
    L = ["## The words and ratios per span (the quadrature of record, Y)", "",
         "| job | span | whole repeats | ratio (a) | word | 1/e lag (sweeps) | sweep | correlation time | per row lag 1 autocorrelation (se) |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for k, nm in NAMES.items():
        j = d["jobs"][k]
        for s in j["spans"]:
            y = s["Y"]
            ct = f"{y['correlation_time_s']:.3f} s ({y['correlation_time_sweeps']} sweeps)" if y["correlation_time_read"] else y["correlation_time_word"]
            L.append(f"| {nm} | {s['span']} | {s['n_whole_repeats']} | {f(y['ratio'])} | **{y['word']}** | {y['lag_1_over_e']} | {y['sweep_s']*1e3:.1f} ms | {ct} | "
                     f"{f(y['row_lag1_autocorrelation_mean'], 3)} ({f(y['row_lag1_se'], 4)}) |")
    L += ["", "## The X quadrature, beside, without words", "",
          "| job | span | ratio (a) | 1/e lag (sweeps) | per row lag 1 autocorrelation (se) |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for k, nm in NAMES.items():
        for s in d["jobs"][k]["spans"]:
            x = s["X"]
            L.append(f"| {nm} | {s['span']} | {f(x['ratio'])} | {x['lag_1_over_e']} | {f(x['row_lag1_autocorrelation_mean'], 3)} ({f(x['row_lag1_se'], 4)}) |")
    L += ["", "## The scatter check (c), with the shared state prediction beside", "",
          "| job | span | Y from the arrays | Y from the counts | Y predicted if shared | X from the arrays | X from the counts | X predicted if shared | b | p_l, p_u in Y |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for k, nm in NAMES.items():
        for s in d["jobs"][k]["spans"]:
            y, x = s["Y"], s["X"]
            lp = y["lines_for_the_prediction"]
            L.append(f"| {nm} | {s['span']} | {f(y['scatter_ratio_from_arrays'], 3)} | {f(y['scatter_ratio_from_counts'], 3)} | {f(y['shared_state_residual_prediction'], 3)} | "
                     f"{f(x['scatter_ratio_from_arrays'], 3)} | {f(x['scatter_ratio_from_counts'], 3)} | {f(x['shared_state_residual_prediction'], 3)} | {f(lp['b'], 3)} | "
                     f"{f(lp['p_l'], 3)}, {f(lp['p_u'], 3)} |")
    L += ["", "## Job 1 (test 11's shuffled job), beside, without words", "",
          "| span | Y rows | Y ratio (a) | Y per row lag 1 (se) | X rows | X ratio (a) | X per row lag 1 (se) |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for s in d["jobs"]["t11-job1-beside"]["spans"]:
        y, x = s["Y"], s["X"]
        L.append(f"| {s['span']} | {y['n_rows']} | {f(y['ratio'])} | {f(y['row_lag1_autocorrelation_mean'], 3)} ({f(y['row_lag1_se'], 4)}) | {x['n_rows']} | {f(x['ratio'])} | "
                 f"{f(x['row_lag1_autocorrelation_mean'], 3)} ({f(x['row_lag1_se'], 4)}) |")
    (OUT / "tables-t13.md").write_text("# Test 13: tables from fits-t13.json\n\n" + "\n".join(L) + "\n")
    print("\n".join(L))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Test 13: the record of every array file's SHA-256 before any reading runs (t13-rule.md, section 3, item 2). Hashes
the files only; opens no array. Writes shots-t13-hashes-before-analysis.txt in the hand-back folder, with the UTC time.
Refuses to overwrite an existing record.

Usage: python -B hashes_t13.py"""
import hashlib
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    p = OUT / "shots-t13-hashes-before-analysis.txt"
    if p.exists():
        sys.exit("refusing: the record exists")
    files = sorted(OUT.glob("shots-t13-*.npz")) + sorted(OUT.glob("shots-t13-*-meta.json"))
    lines = [f"Recorded {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())} (UTC), before any array was opened or any reading ran.", ""]
    lines += [f"{hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}  {f.name}" for f in files]
    p.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    print(p.read_text())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Test 13, the fetch (t13-rule.md, section 3, items 1 and 2). Read-only: no job is created or changed, and no hardware

For each job of the rule's section 2 (and test 11's job 1, read beside), the result is fetched by job id, and for every
position the per-shot bits of its single classical bit are kept in the order the provider returns them
(BitArray.to_bool_array() on the result's register "c", its one column, as 0 and 1). If a position's result carries no
per-shot data, the job is NOT AVAILABLE and that is recorded. The arrays are written to one file per job,
shots-t13-<test>-job<n>.npz, one array per position named p000, p001, ..., each uint8 of length equal to the shots;
beside each, shots-t13-<test>-job<n>-meta.json holds the fetch time in UTC, the job id, the number of positions and
the shots per position as the result states them, and the provider's result metadata (everything under the result's
metadata and each position's own metadata, made JSON-readable).

This script computes nothing from the bits: no count, no mean, nothing printed from them. The shapes it records are
the result's own num_shots and num_bits. After it runs, hashes_t13.py writes shots-t13-hashes-before-analysis.txt.

Usage: python -B fetch_t13.py      Never prints, logs or stores a token, CRN or account identifier."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
JOBS = [("t11", 2, "db9t7v424mrc7384ibh0"), ("t11", 3, "db9t919gv2cc73e61ljg"), ("t12", 1, "dba168hgv2cc73e6732g"),
        ("t11", 1, "db9t6ek24mrc7384i83g")]   # the last read beside, with no verdict


def js(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return {str(k): js(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        return [js(x) for x in v]
    if isinstance(v, (int, float, bool, str)) or v is None:
        return v
    return str(v)
